sources.title: Study guide for Exam AZ-900
sources.scope: Supports fundamentals domain weights and skills heading July 20, 2026. This workshop covers selected concepts only, not the entire exam.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: readable open verified; page last updated June 22, 2026. English updates precede localized versions; approximately eight weeks is guidance, not a guaranteed rollout date.

sources.title: Study guide for Exam AZ-104
sources.scope: Supports stable administration domains and partial gap mapping. Current task-level effective-date verification is incomplete because official indexed and opened versions conflict.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: readable article reviewed, temporal conflict unresolved. Search index shows skills as of April 17, 2026; canonical and tracked opens show October 26, 2023 despite page update October 30, 2026. Do not label the older heading current or silently choose a date.

sources.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
sources.scope: Confirms administrator role, five domains and Last Updated April 17, 2026. Certification metadata does not resolve the conflicting study-guide effective date.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: readable open verified. Linked official short-link study guide could not be fetched; no account access was attempted.

sources.title: Azure Resource Manager overview
sources.scope: Supports resource hierarchy, ARM management, declarative deployment and common lifecycle grouping. Does not validate a deployment.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Manage Azure resource groups
sources.scope: Supports lifecycle grouping and resource-group metadata location versus resource location. Does not establish that every resource can be moved.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure roles and Microsoft Entra roles
sources.scope: Distinguishes directory administration from Azure resource roles. Does not imply Entra administrators automatically own Azure resources.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: What is Azure RBAC?
sources.scope: Supports principal, role, scope, inherited/additive assignments and separate data permissions. Simplified exercises exclude deny assignments and role conditions.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Lock Azure resources
sources.scope: Supports ReadOnly and CanNotDelete control-plane restrictions and inherited locks. Locks are not protection against authorized data-plane deletion.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure Policy overview
sources.scope: Supports policy assignments and effects for governance; policy does not grant RBAC permission. Avoid treating every effect as deny or automatic repair.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Policy compliance evaluation
sources.scope: Supports evaluation triggers, asynchronous scans and periodic compliance checks. A fresh assignment does not imply instant complete compliance reporting.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Remediate non-compliant resources
sources.scope: Supports remediation tasks for modify and deployIfNotExists, with managed-identity permissions. Audit/deny alone do not repair existing resources.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure Storage redundancy
sources.scope: Supports LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS and read-access variants, asynchronous geo-replication and service/region limits. Redundancy is not versioned recovery or zero-data-loss assurance.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Authorize access to Azure Storage
sources.scope: Supports Entra-based authorization and distinctions from Shared Key/SAS. Network connectivity does not grant permission; exact support varies by storage service.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Use private endpoints for Azure Storage
sources.scope: Supports service-specific private endpoints, normal endpoint names and DNS configuration. Does not automatically disable public access or replace authorization.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure Virtual Network overview
sources.scope: Supports private network, subnets, peering and hybrid connectivity concepts. Does not prove end-to-end traffic reachability.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Virtual network traffic routing
sources.scope: Supports route prefix selection, next hops and precedence. Preferred-route and service-endpoint exceptions mean a simplified local selector is not a full Azure route engine.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Network security groups
sources.scope: Supports five-tuple filtering, lower-number priority and stateful flows. Existing sessions may survive a rule edit; NSGs are not application authentication.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure private endpoint DNS configuration
sources.scope: Supports private endpoint name resolution and service-specific zones. DNS results and data authorization are independent.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Choose an Azure compute service
sources.scope: Supports comparing hosting and operational responsibilities. Architecture decision work is enrichment, not comprehensive AZ-900 or AZ-104 coverage.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Virtual Machine Scale Sets overview
sources.scope: Supports instance scaling and availability placement. A scale set alone is not multi-region recovery or immunity to datacenter failure.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure Monitor overview
sources.scope: Supports metrics, logs, analysis, alerts and autoscale concepts. Offline observations do not prove live telemetry or alert delivery.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure Monitor activity log
sources.scope: Supports control-plane change evidence and default 90-day retention. Not a complete record of data reads or application behavior.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Diagnostic settings in Azure Monitor
sources.scope: Supports collection destinations and distinction between default platform signals and opt-in resource logs. Collection needs configuration and has latency.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Azure Backup overview
sources.scope: Supports backup purpose and recovery planning. A successful backup alone does not prove restore usability or achieved RTO.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: About Azure Site Recovery
sources.scope: Supports replication, failover, failback and dependency planning. A design exercise does not prove disaster recovery execution.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Create and manage Azure budgets
sources.scope: Supports actual/forecast alerts, budget periods and delayed cost evaluation. Budgets do not stop resources or impose a spending hard cap.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.

sources.title: Use tags to organize Azure resources
sources.scope: Supports cost attribution metadata, plain-text visibility and lack of automatic resource-tag inheritance. Tags are neither secrets nor access controls.
sources.notes: Retrieval status: opened and relevant article text reviewed on 2026-11-08. Official Microsoft Learn documentation; availability and exact service behavior must be rechecked before live use.
